Retail Manager

Experienced Multi-Site Petrol & Convenience store Manager – Burwood & Mornington Peninsula

Kogan People Solutions is partnering with an established operator to source a high-caliber, fully autonomous Multi-Site Store Manager to oversee two high-volume operations.

This is a solid appointment for an established fuel retail professional. Based primarily at the Blairgowrie site with operational oversight of a second site in Burwood  Vic., you will have total operational accountability from day one. 

•	Are you an established Retail Manager (or up and coming supervisor) currently employed within a similar business?
•	Do you possess knowledge of fuel compliance, wet-stock management, and P&C (petrol and convenience) retail operations?
•	Are you looking for a highly autonomous role where you can manage two sites with complete confidence?

Read on!

Position Overview

•	Location: Based in  Blairgowrie  (with regular operational travel to the Burwood site)

•	Tenure: Full-time, ongoing

•	Salary: $80,000 to $85,000 + superannuation per annum (negotiable for an elite, fully independent performer)

Core Responsibilities 

You will be expected to independently manage and optimize all facets of both locations, including:

•	Multi-Site Leadership: Autonomously managing staff schedules, recruitment, and high-performance team culture across two separate locations.

•	Financial & Inventory Control: Overseeing daily banking, cash mitigation, end-to-end stock control, and wastage minimization.

•	Data-Driven Growth: Immediately diving into the Weekly Sales & Inventory Reports to identify margin improvements and execute immediate commercial strategies.

•	Strict Fuel & Council Compliance: Ensuring 100% adherence to franchisor regulations, council food safety guidelines, and stringent fuel site OHS protocols without supervision.

•	Merchandising: Seamlessly executing in-store marketing, promotional layouts, and maintaining immaculate store presentation.

What we expect to observe in order to be considered:

•	Direct Experience: Minimum 1 years, preferably more, of current or recent experience specifically as a Store Manager or senior supervisor within the Petrol & Convenience / Fuel Retail industry.

•	An understanding of wet-stock management, console/POS operations, P&C compliance, and merchandising.

•	Must hold a full Australian driver’s license and possess the maturity and time-management skills to split your focus between the Burwood and the Peninsula sites effectively.

•	Qualifications: Diploma level qualification or agreed equivalent 

•	Work Rights: Full, unrestricted Australian working rights.

Interested? Applications:

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

  Working Hours:  Full Time or Part Time 

  Salary Offer:  $75k to $110k annually (depending on experience) +  super + CPD allowance + benefits

  About the company:   

 Our client is a specialized center dedicated to providing comprehensive support for individuals with developmental and mental health conditions. Their services cater to a wide range of needs, from early diagnosis to ongoing therapies and family support. Our team of highly experienced clinicians offers assessments for Autism, ADHD, Anxiety, Sensory Processing Challenges, Mental Health Conditions, and more. 

 By bringing together a diverse group of therapists under one roof, they ensure effective communication and collaboration. This team-based approach allows us to deliver the best possible care for our clients, reducing confusion and stress for families. 

 Their services include Occupational Therapy, Speech Pathology, Music Therapy, Art Therapy, and Support Specialist services. The company also offer regular social opportunities groups for all ages, providing a safe and supportive environment for individuals to connect with others and develop valuable social skills.

 Our client is currently looking for a  Speech Pathologist for their Werribee centre. They will also consider someone who would want to work evenings and / or weekends. Job title:  Paediatric Speech Pathologist - Clinic/School Setting - Wollongong 

  Working hours:  Full time or part time 

  Salary offer:  Generous salary offer + professional development support + benefits 

  Location:  Dapto NSW 

   

  About the company:   

 Our client is a leading early intervention multidisciplinary team based in the beautiful Illawarra region. We are a growing team dedicated to providing exceptional support to children aged 0-7 years with developmental delays and disabilities. They are focused on providing essential resources and opportunities to children with developmental vulnerabilities, empowering them to reach their full developmental potential. 

   

  About the role:   

 Our client is looking for a passionate speech pathologist who would love to work either full-time or part-time with flexible hours across schools, early learning services and in their clinic. This role involves providing comprehensive speech pathology services to children of all ages, from early childhood through school age. The successful candidate will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of communication and feeding difficulties, empowering children to reach their full potential. 

  Responsibilities:  

 
	  Assessment and Diagnosis:  Conduct thorough assessments to identify communication and feeding challenges, including articulation difficulties, language delays, comprehension issues, stuttering, voice disorders, social skills deficits, and oral motor dysfunction. 
	  Treatment Planning and Implementation:  Develop and implement individualized treatment plans tailored to each child's specific needs and goals, utilizing evidence-based practices. 
	  Therapy Delivery:  Provide direct therapy services in various settings, including our Dapto clinic, preschools, and schools. Sessions are typically 30 minutes long (face-to-face) for both Allied Health Assistant sessions and sessions with qualified therapists. NDIS sessions are billed for 1 hour (including 45 minutes face-to-face therapy and 15 minutes of essential administrative tasks as required by NDIS guidelines). 
	  Collaboration:  Work collaboratively with parents, families, educators, and other professionals to ensure coordinated and effective care. Provide parents with strategies and tasks to support their child's progress at home. 
	  Educational Linkages:  Align therapy goals with the learning needs of each child's school stage, integrating therapy with school-based learning. 
	  Group Sessions and Intensives:  Participate in and contribute to group therapy sessions and holiday intensive programs. 
	  Documentation:  Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and other relevant documentation. For NDIS clients, this includes the required administrative paperwork within the billable hour.      Apply Now

The Client 
Smart Energy Group is a full-service renewable solar energy company servicing Australia wide. They design and install bespoke solar solutions that reduce the energy costs of Australian households and businesses whilst improving Australia's green footprint.
They are seeking an experienced Office Manager to join their team Sydney, NSW.


The Role
The position is responsible for coordinating office personnel, allocating resources,
maintaining operational standards, managing records and reporting systems, and
ensuring effective communication between internal departments. The role also
contributes to workforce planning, process improvement, staff development, and
operational compliance to support business objectives.
This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $80,000 plus superannuation. 

The Responsibilities
•	Contribute to the planning, development and review of office services, procedures and operational standards
•	Establish priorities and service standards for sales administration and scheduling functions
•	Monitor operational workflows and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency
•	Ensure effective coordination between Sales, Operations, Installation and Administration departments
•	Allocate staffing resources, workloads and operational support based on business requirements
•	Coordinate office resources, equipment and systems to support business activities
•	Monitor team capacity and operational demands to ensure service delivery targets are met
•	Assign work tasks and monitor performance of scheduling and administration staff
•	Provide leadership, coaching, training and ongoing support to team members
•	Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance management processes
•	Assist with recruitment, onboarding and training of new employees
•	Manage office records, operational documentation and reporting systems
•	Ensure accurate maintenance of business records, customer information and sales data
•	Oversee CRM systems, including Salesforce and Field Service Lightning
•	Maintain operational reporting and performance tracking systems
•	Oversee appointment scheduling processes and sales administration activities
•	Coordinate workforce schedules and operational requirements across multiple sales regions
•	Manage planning and logistics for away-trip operations and regional sales activities
•	Liaise with operational departments to align scheduling with installation capacity
•	Liaise with managers, operational teams and other professionals to coordinate business activities
•	Facilitate communication between departments and assist in resolving operational issues
•	Respond to internal stakeholder requests and support continuous business improvement initiatives
•	Ensure office equipment, systems and technology resources are maintained and operational
•	Coordinate system access, software requirements and operational support resources
•	Monitor office supply requirements and administrative resources
•	Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures and operational standards
•	Support adherence to relevant workplace health and safety requirements
•	Ensure business processes comply with privacy legislation and data management requirements
•	Assist with implementing regulatory and organisational compliance initiatives
•	Prepare operational reports and performance metrics for management review
•	Monitor scheduling efficiency, workload distribution and service delivery standards
•	Analyse operational trends and identify opportunities for process improvement
•	Provide recommendations to improve office productivity and operational performance


The Requirements:	
•	Must hold a minimum Degree qualification in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
•	Minimum 3 years of experience in office administration, operations coordination, business support, scheduling or office management roles
•	Minimum 3 years’ experience as an Office Manager or in an office administration management role
•	At least 3 years’ experience coordinating office operations, administrative systems, and business support functions
•	Minimum 3 years’ experience managing records, schedules, correspondence, and operational documentation in a commercial environment
•	At least 3 years’ experience supporting multidisciplinary teams within property, real estate, or customer service environments
•	At least 3 years’ experience using office management systems, Microsoft Office applications, and business administration software
•	Strong knowledge of office administration procedures, workflow coordination, and document management practices
•	Ability to manage competing priorities and maintain operational efficiency in a fast-paced environment
•	Strong organisational, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills
•	Ability to prepare reports, maintain accurate records, and manage confidential information professionally
•	Good understanding of workplace compliance, administrative controls, and customer service standards
•	Ability to work independently and support business operations within structured deadlines
•	High attention to detail and problem-solving capability

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Transform lives, every single day

Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen. 

For over 170 years, Anglicare has supported people and communities across Sydney and the surrounds. Our Seniors Communities portfolio spans Retirement Living and Support at Home services, supporting thousands of older Australians and their families. 

We'relooking for aCyberRisk andControls Analystto join our Cyber Security and IT Risk team. This role focuses onperforming risk assessmentsin accordancewiththe team's practises andguidelines as well as implementing andassessingcyber security controls,in alignment to the Cyber uplift program,supporting governance and compliance initiatives, and helping strengthen Anglicare's cyber security posture. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will contribute to controls assurance activities, risk assessments and continuous monitoring programs that help protect Anglicare's critical systems,dataand digital assets.

As part of a purpose-driven organisation, you'll be working in a collaborative and values-led environment where your work directly contributes to enriching lives and strengthening communities. 

Your opportunity

TheCyber Risk and Controls Analystplaysan important rolein supporting Anglicare's cyber security governance, risk management,and to alesser degree,controlsimplementation andassuranceactivities. You willdeterminesecurityeffectivenessthrough risk assessments,aswell as implementing and assessing cyber security controls, in alignment to the Cyber uplift program,monitorcompliance with security frameworks and standards, and provide insights that help strengthen cyber resilience across the organisation.

Working alongside Cyber Security, ITArchitectureand business stakeholders, you will support control validation, governance frameworks, riskassessmentsand remediation initiatives while helping ensure Anglicaremaintainsa secure and resilient technology environment.

With ownership, you will:

You will support the development and maintenance of governance and compliance frameworks, conduct risk assessments and gap analyses,monitorcontrol performance and remediation activities, and contribute to security assurance initiatives. You will also prepare reports and documentation, support governanceprocessesand work closely with stakeholders to strengthen cyber security controls and reduce organisational risk.

What you'll bring

You are a cyber security professional with experience inrisk assessments,controls assurance,complianceandgovernance. You have agoodunderstanding of cyber security control frameworks,in particular the SCF framework,compliancerequirementsand security best practices, and enjoy analysing complex environments toidentifycontrol gaps and opportunities for improvement.

You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent communication and stakeholder engagement capabilities. You are detail-oriented,collaborativeand proactive, with the ability to translate technical findings into practical recommendations that support business and securityobjectives. You are also committed to continuous learning and staying informed about emerging threats,technologiesand regulatory developments.

You will also need:

- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Cyber Security, RiskManagementor a related field. Certifications such as CRISC, CISM or ISO 27001 are highly desirable.
- 3+ years' experience in cyber security, governance, riskmanagementor compliance-related roles.
- Experience assessing andvalidatingcyber security controls and supporting controls assurance activities.
- Knowledge of cyber security frameworks and standards including SCF, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53 and CIS Controls.
- Experience with control testing, evidence review, gap analysis and remediation tracking.
- Understanding of continuous control monitoring, compliancereportingand security assurance practices.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and risk assessment capabilities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong documentation and reporting skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- Proven ability to collaborate effectively across teams and contribute to organisation-wide cyber security and governance initiatives.

Why Anglicare?

At Anglicare, we provide meaningful opportunities and choice - both for the communities we support and the people who work with us. 

Here'swhatyou'llenjoy: 

Flexible work options to balance life and career. 

Salary packaging benefits - up to $15,900 of your income tax free, plus $2,650 for meals and entertainment. 

Ongoing professional development and career pathways. 

Exclusive staff discounts with over 400 retailers. 

Employee Assistance Program and Fitness Passport with access to 800+ gyms. 

Belonging to a supportive, purpose-driven team committed to making a difference. 

Apply now

Are you ready to help us attract and empower the people who will shape Anglicare's future? To apply, click the'Apply'button andsubmityour resum and cover letter. All applicants will receive a response. Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the communities we serve. While guided by our Christian values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds.

We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders,abilitiesand cultural backgrounds.

result.description:
## Sales and Marketing Manager
## Position Overview
We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Sales and Marketing Manager to lead and execute strategic commercial initiatives across our organisation. This role is central to driving revenue growth, brand positioning, and market expansion through the effective management of both sales operations and marketing programmes. The ideal candidate is a confident leader with a proven track record of delivering measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. You will bring a strategic mindset, strong analytical capability, and the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams.
## Key Responsibilities
- Formulate, implement, and continuously refine integrated sales and marketing strategies, ensuring alignment with broader organisational goals and growth targets
- Develop and oversee advertising, public relations, and promotional campaigns, working collaboratively with internal stakeholders and external agencies to maximise brand impact
- Establish and manage sales territories, customer service standards, and product mix to optimise market coverage and revenue performance
- Direct and coordinate the activities of sales personnel, agents, and distributors to ensure consistent execution of sales methods and commercial objectives
- Set pricing structures, credit arrangements, and discount frameworks in line with market conditions and company profitability targets
- Oversee merchandising methods and distribution policy, ensuring product availability and visibility across all relevant channels
- Monitor and analyse market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to inform strategic decision-making and identify new business opportunities
- Develop and manage the sales and marketing budget, tracking expenditure and return on investment to ensure efficient allocation of resources
- Lead the generation and nurturing of leads across digital and traditional channels, converting pipeline opportunities into long-term client relationships
- Produce regular performance reports and present findings to senior leadership, providing data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and industry stakeholders to support retention and business development
- Recruit, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and professional growth
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline
- Minimum of 5 years' experience in a sales and/or marketing management role, with demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding commercial targets
- Strong understanding of both B2B and B2C sales environments, including pipeline management and customer lifecycle strategies
- Proven experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns, including digital, content, and traditional media
- Proficiency in CRM platforms and marketing automation tools, with the ability to leverage data for strategic insight
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present to senior stakeholders and external partners
- Demonstrated leadership capability, with experience managing, coaching, and developing sales and marketing teams
- High level of commercial acumen and a customer-centric approach to business development
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within deadlines
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualification such as a Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent
- Professional accreditation with the Australian Marketing Institute (AMI) or a recognised industry body
- Experience working within a specific industry relevant to our business, such as retail, technology, professional services, or FMCG
- Familiarity with SEO, SEM, and performance marketing strategies, as well as experience managing digital advertising budgets
- Exposure to international or cross-regional markets, including an understanding of export or distribution networks
- Experience with sales enablement tools, marketing analytics platforms, or enterprise-level CRM systems such as Salesforce or HubSpot
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values innovation, initiative, and professional development
- Access ongoing learning and career progression opportunities, including support for further study, industry certifications, and leadership programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available, supporting a healthy work-life balance
- Benefit from a competitive remuneration package, including performance-based incentives that reward your contribution to the business
- Join a team culture built on trust, inclusivity, and shared purpose, where your ideas are heard and your impact is recognised
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

About the Role
Safe Height Pty Ltd trading as SAFE MOUNT are a specialist provider of Height Safety Compliance  Solutions across SEQ. Our services include System Design, Installation of Height Safety Systems, Certification and Audit, as well as Harness & PPE Inspection services. Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Project Administrator to support the planning, coordination and administration of multiple concurrent projects and service programs for the existing and new clients. The role requires regular travel along southeast Queensland between various projects with possible interstate trips. This role suits a highly capable, analytically-minded professional — potentially with an engineering, scientific, mining or other complex industrial background — who can quickly learn technical and regulatory frameworks, interpret data and adapt across multiple concurrent, complex projects as per various customers’ requirements. 

Skills
-  Project Coordination
-  Contract Administration
-  Contract Management
-  Project Scheduling
-  Microsoft Excel
-  Project Reporting
-  Contractor Management
-  Stakeholder Management
-  Compliance Management

Skills & Experience
-  Tertiary qualification in a technical, engineering, scientific, project management, business or related discipline.
-  Background in engineering, construction, mining, resources, manufacturing or other complex industrial/technical sectors will be highly regarded.
-  Minimum 3 years’ experience in project coordination, project administration, project controls or similar project support roles.
-  Demonstrated experience managing interfaces between clients, contractors, suppliers and technical professionals.
-  Experience coordinating projects involving technical design, site installation works, contractor management and regulatory compliance requirements.
-  Experience in schedule monitoring, progress tracking and project performance reporting.
-  Experience in communication with different levels of stakeholders from site labour to decision makers in the client's procurement team
-  Experience supporting project change management and contract variation processes.
-  Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including reporting, forecasting, data analysis and performance tracking.

Job Closure date:	30 Days

Position Overview: Mygration is engaged to source the following position for our client
Our client is a leading innovator in the design, fabrication, and installation of high-quality steel structures and electrical systems for industrial and commercial applications. With a strong focus on engineering excellence, safety, and precision, they deliver cutting-edge solutions across various sectors, including infrastructure, energy, and manufacturing.

We are seeking a skilled Electrical Engineering Technician to join their dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in supporting the design, installation, and maintenance of electrical systems for heavy machinery, substations, and industrial control systems. You will work closely with engineers and technologists to ensure all electrical installations meet industry standards, safety regulations, and project specifications.

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented professional with strong technical skills and a passion for electrical systems within an industrial and structural engineering environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design & Documentation:
• Prepare detailed electrical drawings, schematics, and layout plans for industrial installations, including substations, switchgear, motor control systems, and cabling networks.
• Develop wiring diagrams and termination schedules for control panels used in heavy machinery & manufacturing and automation systems.

Technical Support:
• Assist electrical engineers in the design, testing, and optimization of electrical systems for machinery & manufacturing and structural projects.
• Troubleshoot and diagnose faults in PLC-controlled systems, including servo drives and variable frequency drives (VFDs).

Testing & Analysis:
• Conduct electrical tests, perform complex calculations, and analyse data to validate system performance.
• Perform insulation resistance (IR) testing, earth continuity checks, and thermal imaging on high-voltage equipment.

Cost Estimation:
• Assist in estimating material quantities, costs, and project timelines.
• Evaluate supplier quotations for electrical components (e.g., circuit breakers, contactors) to ensure cost-effective procurement.

Quality Assurance:
• Inspect electrical installations and finished products for compliance with specifications.
• Verify that all electrical work adheres to AS/NZS 3000 and IEC standards before commissioning.

Installation & Maintenance:
• Assemble, install, calibrate, and repair electrical equipment, including protection relays and metering devices.
• Perform preventive maintenance on industrial motor control centres (MCCs) to minimize downtime.

Workshop Operations:
• Undertake workshop duties, including wiring, testing, and modifying electrical assemblies.
• Fabricate and test custom control panels for machinery integration.

Research & Development:
• Contribute to R&D initiatives by assisting in experimental programs.
• Assist in the testing and integration of renewable energy systems (e.g., solar inverters) into industrial power networks.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:
• Trade Certification or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
• Proven experience in electrical drafting, machinery wiring, or industrial electrical systems and manufacturing fabrications.
• Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical) for schematic and layout design.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform technical calculations and interpret test data.
• Knowledge of industry standards, including AS/NZS 3000 and electrical safety regulations.
• Hands-on experience with motor controls, switchgear, PLCs, and protection systems is highly desirable.
• Workshop & fabrication skills, including the ability to assemble and troubleshoot electrical components.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and project teams.
• At least 2 years of Full-time on the job work experience.

WHY APPLY?
• Work with a forward-thinking company at the forefront of industrial and structural engineering.
• Engage in high-impact projects involving cutting-edge electrical systems.
• Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
• Competitive remuneration and a supportive team environment.

If you are a motivated Electrical Engineering Technician with a passion for precision and innovation, we encourage you to apply! Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Please note: We are recruiting on behalf of our client. All applications will be treated with confidentiality.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented and highly organised Program or Project Administrator to support the effective delivery of organisational programs and special projects. In this role, you will serve as a central point of coordination, ensuring administrative functions run smoothly and that project activities are tracked, documented, and communicated with precision. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capabilities, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. This is a key support role suited to a proactive professional who thrives on keeping complex initiatives on track.
## Key Responsibilities
- Provide high-level administrative support across multiple programs and projects, ensuring all activities are coordinated efficiently and align with organisational objectives
- Advise senior management on emerging matters requiring attention, prepare briefing materials, and follow through on the implementation of their decisions
- Prepare, review, and distribute submissions, reports, and correspondence relating to program and project activities, ensuring accuracy and adherence to organisational standards
- Collect, organise, and analyse data associated with ongoing projects, monitoring progress against milestones and reporting on outcomes to key stakeholders
- Oversee the work of contractors and external service providers, tracking deliverables and reporting on any variations to agreed work orders or scopes
- Maintain and update project documentation including schedules, risk registers, action logs, and status reports throughout the project lifecycle
- Coordinate meetings, workshops, and project-related events, including preparation of agendas, minute-taking, and follow-up on action items
- Liaise with internal teams, external partners, and stakeholders to facilitate clear communication and ensure project information is shared in a timely manner
- Review and coordinate arrangements for office accommodation and workspace requirements, supporting the organisation's operational and project-related needs
- Support budget administration by tracking expenditure, processing invoices, and flagging variances to project managers or senior leadership
- Assist in the development and continuous improvement of administrative systems, processes, and templates to enhance project delivery efficiency
- Ensure compliance with relevant policies, procedures, and governance frameworks across all program and project administration activities
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A qualification in business administration, project management, or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience in a similar role
- Demonstrated experience in a program or project administration role within a corporate, government, or professional services environment
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint, as well as project management or collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Asana, or similar platforms
- Proven ability to analyse data, produce clear and accurate reports, and present findings to varied audiences including senior management
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft professional correspondence, submissions, and reports to a high standard
- Highly developed organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing project demands
- Sound understanding of project management principles and the ability to apply them in a practical administrative context
- Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively within cross-functional teams, demonstrating initiative and sound judgement
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy across all documentation and reporting outputs
## Preferred Qualifications
- A CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, or active progress towards one
- Experience working within a PMO (Project Management Office) environment
- Familiarity with contract administration processes and managing third-party service providers
- Exposure to government or regulated industry environments where compliance and governance requirements are particularly stringent
- Experience supporting large-scale or multi-stream programs involving diverse stakeholder groups
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture where your contributions are recognised and valued
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with work arrangements designed to support work-life balance
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for further study and project management certifications
- Work on meaningful programs and projects that make a tangible impact within the organisation and the communities it serves
- Competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression into senior project or program management roles
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
